title: Kitten reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <polygon points='28,62 50,58 50,82 28,86' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <polygon points='50,58 72,62 72,86 50,82' fill='#ffb703'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#f77f00' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- pages -->
    <polygon points='30,63 49,59.5 49,80 30,83' fill='#fff3b0'/>
    <polygon points='51,59.5 70,63 70,83 51,80' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <!-- text lines on pages -->
    <line x1='33' y1='67' x2='46' y2='64.5' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='71' x2='46' y2='68.5' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='75' x2='44' y2='72.5' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='64.5' x2='67' y2='67' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='68.5' x2='67' y2='71' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='72.5' x2='65' y2='75' stroke='#d62828' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- chest fluff -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#fff1d0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='18' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='36,20 32,4 46,15' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <polygon points='64,20 68,4 54,15' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <polygon points='37,18 35,8 45,16' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <polygon points='63,18 65,8 55,16' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='30' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2b2d42'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2b2d42'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='48,37 52,37 50,40' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M47 41 Q50 44 53 41' fill='none' stroke='#e76f51' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='35' x2='40' y2='37' stroke='#fff1d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='40' x2='40' y2='40' stroke='#fff1d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='35' x2='60' y2='37' stroke='#fff1d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='40' x2='60' y2='40' stroke='#fff1d0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='76' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='76' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- paw toes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='73' r='2' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='73' r='2' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffb4a2'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q86 60 84 44 Q82 34 74 36' fill='none' stroke='#f4a261' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 62 Q86 60 84 44 Q82 34 74 36' fill='none' stroke='#ffb4a2' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='4 6'/>
</svg>
